criteria.text: Chronic LBP must have lasted 12 weeks or longer.
criteria.if_missing: How long has the patient's low back pain lasted (in weeks)?

criteria.text: The low back pain must be nonspecific, with no identifiable systemic cause.
criteria.source_quote: nonspecific, in that it has no identifiable systemic cause
criteria.if_missing: Is the low back pain nonspecific, without an identifiable systemic cause (e.g., not metastatic, inflammatory, infectious disease)?

criteria.text: The low back pain must not be associated with surgery.
criteria.if_missing: Is the low back pain associated with a prior surgery?

criteria.text: The low back pain must not be associated with pregnancy.
criteria.if_missing: Is the low back pain associated with pregnancy?

criteria.text: Up to 12 visits in 90 days are covered initially.
criteria.source_quote: Up to 12 visits in 90 days are covered
criteria.if_missing: How many acupuncture visits has the patient had in the current 90-day period?
criteria.short: Exceeds 12 visits in 90 days (without documented improvement for additional sessions)

criteria.text: An additional 8 sessions are covered only for patients demonstrating improvement.
criteria.source_quote: An additional 8 sessions will be covered for those patients demonstrating an improvement.
criteria.if_missing: Is there documentation that the patient is improving with acupuncture treatment?
criteria.short: No documented improvement to justify additional 8 sessions

criteria.text: No more than 20 acupuncture treatments may be administered annually.
criteria.source_quote: No more than 20 acupuncture treatments may be administered annually
criteria.if_missing: How many acupuncture treatments has the patient received this year?

criteria.text: Treatment must be discontinued if the patient is not improving or is regressing.
criteria.source_quote: Treatment must be discontinued if the patient is not improving or is regressing.
criteria.if_missing: Is there documentation that the patient is not improving or is regressing?
criteria.short: Patient not improving or regressing - treatment should be discontinued

criteria.text: Physicians furnishing acupuncture must do so in accordance with applicable state requirements.
criteria.source_quote: may furnish acupuncture in accordance with applicable state requirements
criteria.if_missing: Does the furnishing physician meet applicable state requirements for acupuncture?
criteria.short: Physician does not meet state requirements

criteria.text: PAs, NPs/CNSs, and auxiliary personnel must have a masters or doctoral level degree in acupuncture or Oriental Medicine from an ACAOM-accredited school.
criteria.source_quote:
a masters or doctoral level degree in acupuncture or Oriental Medicine from a school accredited by the Accreditation
Commission on Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (ACAOM)
criteria.if_missing: Does the furnishing non-physician provider have a masters or doctoral degree in acupuncture/Oriental Medicine from an ACAOM-accredited school?
criteria.short: Non-physician provider lacks required ACAOM-accredited degree

criteria.text: PAs, NPs/CNSs, and auxiliary personnel must have a current, full, active, and unrestricted license to practice acupuncture.
criteria.source_quote: a current, full, active, and unrestricted license to practice acupuncture in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth
criteria.if_missing: Does the furnishing non-physician provider have a current, full, active, and unrestricted license to practice acupuncture?
criteria.short: Non-physician provider lacks required unrestricted license

criteria.text: Auxiliary personnel furnishing acupuncture must be under the appropriate level of supervision required by regulations.
criteria.source_quote:
Auxiliary personnel furnishing acupuncture must be under the appropriate level of supervision of a physician, PA, or
NP/CNS required by our regulations at 42 CFR Sec.Sec. 410.26 and 410.27.
criteria.if_missing: Is the auxiliary personnel furnishing acupuncture under the required level of physician/PA/NP/CNS supervision per 42 CFR 410.26/410.27?

criteria.text: Acupuncture (including dry needling) is non-covered for any condition other than cLBP.
criteria.source_quote: All types of acupuncture including dry needling for any condition other than cLBP are non-covered by Medicare.
criteria.if_missing: Is the acupuncture being furnished for chronic low back pain (cLBP) as opposed to another condition?
criteria.short: Acupuncture furnished for condition other than cLBP
